title: Propagation Direction of Bistable Traveling Fronts in the Lotka--Volterra Competition--Diffusion System
summary: We study the propagation direction of bistable traveling fronts in the two-species Lotka--Volterra competition--diffusion system under strong competition. A complete characterization of the sign of the wave speed has remained a long-standing unsolved problem. We establish the first global necessary and sufficient criterion for zero wave speed by combining a Maxwell-type identity with a phase-plane rigidity argument.
